thread: maya-docs: FYI i'm opening a small PR to add a dedicated section for VPN/proxy patterns in private/on-prem installs (wireguard, openvpn, ssh-tunnel examples + cert/keystore notes). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2033 hao-net: :+1: important. include both IP-based and hostname routing examples. many sealed sites use a tunneled mgmt network, so show how to forward the HSM management port over the VPN. maya-docs: plan: short patterns (wireguard peer config, OpenVPN route-push, SSH local/remote forwarding), sample firewall rules for nftables and iptables, and an "airgap import" checklist for bundles. zara-sre: also add cert/keystore guidance: how to present the HSM TLS cert to the agent when the proxy terminates TLS (mutual auth gotchas). show how to preserve client certs through the proxy or use TLS passthrough. hao-net: please include these concrete snippets: wireguard peer allowed-ips example, openvpn server push routes, and ssh remote-forward example. e.g.: ``` # wireguard peer (client) [Peer] PublicKey = AllowedIPs = 10.200.0.0/24, 10.2.0.5/32 Endpoint = vpn-gw.example:51820 ``` ``` # ssh remote forward to expose HSM port locally ssh -R 15001:127.0.0.1:15001 jumpbox@edge -N -f ``` maya-docs: adding. for proxy TLS notes, i'll show nginx stream passthrough vs ssl_preread and an example nginx stream config for passthrough so mutual TLS reaches the HSM: ``` stream { upstream hsm_backend { server 10.2.0.5:15001; } server { listen 15001; proxy_pass hsm_backend; } } ``` zara-sre: good. also include an ssl-termination example for cases where the proxy holds the cert and presents a different trust anchor to inside services. note: if proxy terminates mTLS, you must translate client cert info into headers and secure the header transport. mention the security caveat. maya-docs: will do. adding a short diagram in the doc (list style) showing termination vs passthrough flows. hao-net: for firewall rules include nftables example for wireguard + allow mgmt port only over vpn interface: ``` # allow HSM port only from wg0 add rule inet filter input iifname "wg0" tcp dport 15001 accept add rule inet filter input tcp dport 15001 drop ``` maya-docs: adding iptables equivalence and a note about host-based policies vs cloud security groups. also an example for AWS VPN customers: security group egress to HSM subnet. zara-sre: bundle verification section please: checksum + gpg signature steps we expect partners to run before importing offline bundles. small script example useful. maya-docs: adding GPG + sha256 example: ```bash # verify checksum sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 # verify signature gpg --keyring ./trustedkeys.gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz ``` zara-sre: add a troubleshooting table for the doc: symptom -> likely cause -> quick fix. e.g.: - "VPN up but HSM unreachable" -> "route missing / allowed-ips mismatch" -> "check wg show and ip route" - "TLS handshake fails at proxy" -> "proxy terminated mTLS or wrong cipher" -> "switch to passthrough or update proxy config" hao-net: include a small note about MTU (wireguard defaults can break large payloads esp. with tunnels-in-tunnels). give example to lower MTU: `PostUp = ip link set mtu 1400 dev wg0`. maya-docs: good. adding MTU and TCP MSS clamp notes. also include ssh keepalive flags for long imports: `-o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3`. ci-bot: docs linkcheck: PR #2033 - flagged missing anchor docs/private/network#vpn-proxy-patterns -> 404. maya-docs: thanks CI. i'll add explicit anchor id `` above the section to keep links stable. zara-sre: small PKCS11/keystore caveat: when proxy performs TLS termination, clients that use PKCS11 modules behind the proxy may not be able to use hardware-backed keys unless you enable TLS passthrough. call that out and provide a short fallback: mount PKCS11 socket to proxy host or use ssh forward. maya-docs: adding a "what not to do" bullet: don't terminate mTLS at an untrusted proxy without an authenticated header exchange. also note preserving SANs for healthchecks. hao-net: please add a minimal troubleshooting command list for quick ops triage: `wg show`, `ip route get`, `ss -lnp | grep 15001`, `curl --unix-socket /var/run/redwood/hsm.sock -X GET http://localhost/health` (for socket cases). maya-docs: added. including example curl over unix-socket and `openssl s_client` for TCP paths. ops-bot: CI / docs lint: long lines detected in code blocks. please wrap and re-run. maya-docs: wrapping lines now, pushing fix, and will request a review from
